description: Consolidated iteration-3 figure: LRIT2 gene constraint, micro-exon variant density, and splice-site percentile sensitivity
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

C=pd.read_csv("out_LRIT2_gnomad_gene_constraint.csv").dropna(subset=["LOEUF"])
S=pd.read_csv("out_LRIT2_splice_background_sensitivity.csv")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15.5,4.6))

a=ax[0]
a.bar(C.gene,C.LOEUF,color=["#d1495b" if s=="LRIT2" else "#2c6fbb" for s in C.gene])
a.axhline(1.0,ls="--",color="grey")
a.text(len(C)-0.45,1.03,"observed equals expected",fontsize=7.5,color="grey",ha="right")
a.set_ylabel("gnomAD v4 LOEUF")
a.set_title("LRIT2 has no loss-of-function constraint\nlabels: observed / expected LoF variants",fontsize=10)
for i,(v,o,e) in enumerate(zip(C.LOEUF,C.obs_lof,C.exp_lof)):
    a.text(i,v+0.03,f"{int(o)}/{e:.0f}",ha="center",fontsize=7.5)

a=ax[1]
reg=["constitutive\nexon 1","constitutive\nexon 2","micro-exon","intron\ncontrol"]
dens=[257.4,238.1,333.3,293.5]
a.bar(range(4),dens,color=["#2c6fbb","#2c6fbb","#d1495b","#8d99ae"])
a.axhline(293.5,ls="--",color="#8d99ae")
a.set_xticks(range(4)); a.set_xticklabels(reg,fontsize=8.5)
a.set_ylabel("gnomAD v4 genome variants per kb")
a.set_title("Micro-exon variant density matches intron\n10 observed vs 8.8 expected, Poisson p = 0.73",fontsize=10)
a.text(2,340,"10 variants\nin 30 bp",ha="center",fontsize=7.5,color="#d1495b")

a=ax[2]
x=np.arange(len(S))
a.plot(x,S.acc_pct,"o-",color="#2c6fbb",lw=2,label="acceptor, reference allele")
a.plot(x,S.acc_var_pct,"s--",color="#d1495b",lw=2,label="acceptor, 1.16% variant")
a.plot(x,S.don_pct,"^-",color="#6a994e",lw=2,label="donor, reference allele")
a.axhline(50,ls=":",color="grey")
a.set_xticks(x); a.set_xticklabels([b.split(",")[0] for b in S.background],fontsize=7.5,rotation=12)
a.set_ylim(0,100); a.set_ylabel("percentile of real chr10 splice sites")
a.set_xlabel("background set used to build the PWM")
a.legend(fontsize=7.5,loc="lower left")
a.set_title("Splice-site percentile shifts with the background,\nbut both sites stay at or above the median",fontsize=10)

plt.suptitle("LRIT2 micro-exon: human population variation and splice-site strength",fontsize=12.5)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("acceptor percentile across 3 backgrounds:",list(S.acc_pct),"median",np.median(S.acc_pct))
print("donor percentile across 2 backgrounds:",[v for v in S.don_pct if pd.notna(v)])
print("variant percentile across 2 backgrounds:",[v for v in S.acc_var_pct if pd.notna(v)])
